user.title: Set up update notes
user.description: Fetches the release notes for every pending update (Home Assistant, add-ons/apps, HACS) and fires the `update_notizen_bericht` event on the configured schedule. Adjust schedule and size under “Configure” afterwards.

init.title: Report schedule
init.description: The report fires from the given time at the given interval – with 24 h that is daily at that time.

data.nur_bei_aenderung: Only report when the pending updates changed

abrufen.name: Fetch notes
abrufen.description: Returns the release notes for pending updates (response with updates and integrationen).

entity_id.name: Updates
entity_id.description: Only these update entities; empty = all pending.
